summary: A distributed fix reached 14 repos with the rule explaining it reaching none of them. #1209 added the claim protocol to the template's ROOT AGENTS.md and distributed scripts/claim.sh to every satellite. Checked afterwards against a real satellite rather than the drift report: claim.sh present on tabsii-crm dev, AGENTS.md mentions of it = 0. A satellite's AGENTS.md comes from filesFromSkeleton — the SKELETON's copy — not the repo root, which is the instance ruleset carrying section 9 and the upgrade flow. So editing the root reached instances via core upgrade and no satellite at all: 14 repos got a script with nothing telling them to run it. This is the same defect the fix was for, reproduced inside its own fix. Separately, merging a change to scripts/verify.sh (a shared file) without re-running shared-sync re-drifted all 14 within the hour — the rule 'not done until --check is clean' applies to CHANGING a listed file, not only to adding one
